about: Behaviour cases for watch v2 (issue #7 revision 2). 'mock' cases run in docs/design/watch_v2_mock.py --behaviour and 06 ports them to bin/agentbus; '06' cases need the live loop and are 06's to write in tests/test_watch_keys.sh.

cases.name: pause-rollover
cases.checks: Paused on #9, a snapshot of #10-#209 arrives: #9 stays selected and visible, the title says +200 new, at 40x16 to 100x30; a filter while paused searches the frozen records; resume shows the newest.

cases.name: selection-never-hidden
cases.checks: Every row of every section selected at 40x16 to 100x30, with and without emoji: exactly one > row, and no '0 more', '0 earlier' or '0 later'.

cases.name: kind-codes
cases.checks: kind:ask equals kind:question, kind:ALRT equals kind:alert; the error lists the codes and stays after Enter.

cases.name: filter-coverage
cases.checks: kind:alert on 209 messages: 0 of newest 200, 9 older not searched, n/a for the other sections; topic:, everyone and to:all.

cases.name: long-input
cases.checks: An 80-character filter, kept and typed, at 40, 60 and 100 columns: the footer fits and keeps Esc clear, ? help, q quit; the input scrolls to its cursor.

cases.name: detail-wraps
cases.checks: 16-character names and six-digit ids wrap by field at 40 and 60 columns; a 93-character resource is whole.

cases.name: thread-limits
cases.checks: A message with 25 ancestors and 25 replies: 20 of each, labelled, with the route to the rest.

cases.name: wrap-linear
cases.checks: Wrapping twice the text (one unbroken word) measures at most 2.1 times the cells (counted, not timed), and is cached by text and width.

cases.name: busy-keeps-frame
cases.checks: Busy: every row but the header equals the frame before, the header says waiting · 27s old; also in a detail.

cases.name: claim-holder-idle
cases.checks: Claim detail shows the holder's real activity dot: ○ codex · implementer · seen 6m ago.

cases.name: ascii-only
cases.checks: Every ASCII-mode frame is pure ASCII (so ambiguous-width settings cannot move a column).

cases.name: summary-and-agents
cases.checks: The header says 1 alert · 1 open question (1 ALRT · 1 ask narrow); agents show 2 unread · holds src/auth/; following says k browse.

cases.name: detail-marks
cases.checks: The open message is marked *, nothing is selected on open, the reply command shows, Esc/q back replaces q quit, an ancestor outside the 200 can be selected, and a nested detail says where back goes.

cases.name: mentions-instr
cases.checks: A resource with _ matches only itself (instr, not LIKE).

cases.name: busy-q-under-250ms
cases.checks: Another process holds an EXCLUSIVE lock on bus.db; q in a running watch exits in under 250 ms + 100 ms slack, with termios restored; the frame before the lock stays on screen with waiting · Ns old.

cases.name: input-never-waits-on-sql
cases.checks: While a read is blocked on the lock, 20 keys each redraw in under 100 ms (the read runs off the input loop).

cases.name: detail-queries-on-open-and-r
cases.checks: With a detail open for 5 ticks, watch_detail runs once; r runs it once more.

cases.name: scan-bounded
cases.checks: On a 20000-message bus every detail query reads at most the newest 5000 (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN uses the id range) and the lists say in newest 5000.

cases.name: esc-and-q-back-one-level
cases.checks: Overview, Enter on #7, j, Enter on #9: Esc shows #7, q shows the overview byte for byte, q quits.

cases.name: pause-freezes-display
cases.checks: Paused for 10 ticks while messages arrive: no row changes but the +N new title; ages do not tick.

cases.name: pause-rollover-pty
cases.checks: The pause-rollover case through a pty: pause on #9, post 200 messages, #9 still selected; resize keeps it.

cases.name: view-survives-errors
cases.checks: Filter, select, pause, open a detail; refuse the bus, then repair it: the same frame comes back.

cases.name: copy-osc52
cases.checks: y on #9 in detail writes ESC ] 52 ; c ; base64(reply command) BEL and the copied footer; nothing in bus.db changes.

cases.name: ascii-auto
cases.checks: TERM=linux and AGENTBUS_ASCII=1 each give the ascii goldens; a terminal that reports ● two columns wide (cursor position probe at start) does too.

cases.name: header-sgr
cases.checks: The header bar is SGR 30;43 (no 1), and 7 under TERM=linux or AGENTBUS_ASCII; the error reason has no SGR 2.
